answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral and links signed votes by provenance. When k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence applies a penalty of O(k^2), rather than k isolated fines. Upon detection, escrow seizure, asymmetric depreciation, and recursive loss impose an exponential capital-loss multiplier, so a sybil swarm enters a loss spiral. Even an onyx-labelled cohort cannot hide across a meadow of aliases.
